examples.english: In the same way, all those who have ever set foot on the deck of the Caleuche are also considered idiots and forgetful, because the crewmembers of the infernal ship need to ensure in this way the secrecy of what happens on it and what profane eyes have seen.
examples.ref: 1915, Julio Vicuña Cifuentes, Mitos y Supersticiones Recogidos de la Tradición Oral Chilena, page 27:
examples.text: De la misma manera quedan todos los que han pisado una vez la cubierta del Caleuche, y además idiotas y desmemoriados, pues los tripulantes del buque infernal necesitan asegurar de esta manera el secreto de lo que en él ocurre y ojos profanos han visto.
examples.translation: In the same way, all those who have ever set foot on the deck of the Caleuche are also considered idiots and forgetful, because the crewmembers of the infernal ship need to ensure in this way the secrecy of what happens on it and what profane eyes have seen.
